gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans keeps the tails of its curves held well back. Shantell Sans is best at wide-mouthed, fixed-nib display lettering, while Alan Sans is best at modern, professional text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-albert-sans: This body text reads contemporary, with openings that stay clear at tiny sizes. Albert Sans draws strokes of uniform thickness, echoing the fixed nib of Shantell Sans, and that shared line is what ties them.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-alef: Alef reads modern and clean, its curves left open-ended. Down a full page it feels open and unhurried, while the Shantell Sans heading bends its strokes like paperclip wire.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Alegreya Sans SC leaves a welcoming gap in the c. Shantell Sans cuts every stroke end from one ribbon, and that single-minded line is what makes the pairing so memorable.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-amarna: Clean and unclogged, Amarna keeps its smallest counters open. Shantell Sans brings the expressive swagger, and its fixed nib finds a natural match in the contrast-free strokes of Amarna.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-andika: Shantell Sans arrives with a wide mouth and a single fixed nib width, loud and expressive. And Andika, a modern sans, gives its tails the same weight as its stems and lets the s turn wide.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-anta: Wide mouths and a fixed nib: that is Shantell Sans leading the page. Anta follows with wire-bent letters of constant thickness and gaping e mouths, so the heading's expressive energy gets a steady partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-antic: One nib, two voices: a wide-mouthed heading and a quieter body. Antic keeps the nib-drawn look going, its open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs, while Shantell Sans supplies the expressive flourish up top.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads modern, its brush-like ends lifting away before curves close. Shantell Sans is best at rope-thick, wide-mouthed display curves, while AR One Sans is best at contemporary text with that lifted finish.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-assistant: Every stroke of Shantell Sans has a pipe-like body, with mouths cut wide. Assistant, a sans-serif, keeps its mouths open on c, e, and a, leaving the heading free to carry all the personality.
